name: Changelog / 变更记录
description: One row per merged change, in one plain sentence, written by whoever merged it. / 每次合并一条，用一句人话写清楚，由合并的人或 Agent 当场写。

label.en: Log a change I just merged

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-rnd` skill in this folder, then the `rnd-coder` skill, and follow them. Write one changelog row for the pull request I name: one plain sentence a non-engineer understands, the kind, product, linked task, merge date, link, and how it was verified. Check that the same link is not already logged.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-rnd` Skill，再读 `rnd-coder` Skill，按它们的流程做。为我指定的 PR 写一条变更记录：一句非工程师也看得懂的话，类型、产品、关联任务、合并日期、链接和验证情况。先确认同一个链接没记过。

label.en: Backfill merges that have no changelog entry
label.zh-CN: 从 git 补记漏写的合并

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-rnd` skill in this folder, then the `rnd-coder` skill, and follow them. Compare last week's merged pull requests in this repository with the changelog and add a row for each one that is missing, marking it as backfilled from git. Show me the list first.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-rnd` Skill，再读 `rnd-coder` Skill，按它们的流程做。对比这个仓库上周合并的 PR 和变更记录，为每个漏记的合并补一条，并注明「从 git 补记」。写入前先给我看清单。

label.en: Draft release notes for a version
label.zh-CN: 生成某个版本的版本说明

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-rnd` skill in this folder, then the `rnd-pmo` skill, and follow them. Collect the changes for the product and version I name and write release notes in the Reports table as a draft, grouped into new, improved and fixed, in words users understand.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-rnd` Skill，再读 `rnd-pmo` Skill，按它们的流程做。汇总我指定产品和版本的变更，在「周报与产出」表里写一份版本说明草稿，分「新功能 / 优化 / 修复」三组，用用户听得懂的话。
